name: Custom Products Report
query:
SELECT
    i.name AS "Item Code:Link/Item:150",
    i.item_name AS "Item Name::200",
    i.item_group AS "Item Group::120",
    SUM(b.actual_qty) AS "Total Stock:Float:100",
    SUM(b.ordered_qty) AS "Total Ordered Qty:Float:100",
    SUM(b.reserved_qty) AS "Total Reserved Qty:Float:100"
FROM
    `tabItem` i
INNER JOIN
    `tabBin` b ON i.name = b.item_code
WHERE
    i.item_group = 'Custom Products'
GROUP BY
    i.name, i.item_name, i.item_group
ORDER BY
    i.name;
